name: What information should I gather to help my rideshare accident claim?
description: Gather photos, videos, contact information, insurance details, police reports, medical records, lost wage documentation, and expense receipts.

mainEntity.name: What information should I gather to help my rideshare accident claim?

acceptedAnswer.text: To strengthen your rideshare accident claim, gather as much information as possible. This includes photos and videos of the accident scene, vehicle damage, and injuries. Obtain contact and insurance information for all involved parties, including the rideshare driver and any witnesses. Request the police report and any medical records related to your injuries. Keep records of lost wages, receipts for out-of-pocket expenses, and documentation of your pain and suffering. Your lawyer will use this evidence to build your case.
acceptedAnswer.description: Gather photos, videos, contact information, insurance details, police reports, medical records, lost wage documentation, and expense receipts.
